Subject: Luminova pilot — recap & next steps (cost constraints, batching/caching, quantization)

Evan — thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap of what we heard and proposed next steps so your team has a single reference. Please correct anything I missed.

High-level pain points you shared:
- Unit token cost is the gating factor for productizing the recommendations feature (current infra is blowing budget at peak).
- Large variance in concurrency (batchy nightly jobs + unpredictable daytime spikes).
- Inconsistent latency on long-tail requests (p95 currently ~700ms on target models).

Current stack (as described):
- In-house transformer endpoints on k8s with mixed CPU/GPU nodes.
- Model variants: fp16 on GPU for high-priority; CPU fallback for cheaper throughput.
- No formal quantization strategy in production; some PoCs with dynamic quant but not in prod.

Success criteria you called out:
- Per-token cost target: reduce billed inference cost by ~55% vs today (target number: $0.00014 / token).
- Latency: p95 < 300ms for interactive flows.
- Reliability: 99.9% availability during production windows.
- Pilot scope: validate batching/caching and quantization gains on 2 main models and 1 high-volume inference route.

What Redwood can do in the pilot:
- Run a 4-week controlled pilot: host test model variants in our shared dev environment + optional dedicated reservation run for scale tests.
- Measure unit economics (tokens/sec, GPU utilization, effective cost/token) across configurations (batch sizes, KV caching, INT8/4 quantized models).
- Provide a side-by-side latency/cost dashboard and recommended configuration (batching policy + cache TTL + quantization profile) tied to your traffic mix.

Open questions / asks from your side:
- Can you share a sample 24h call volume breakdown and a small prompt corpus (anonymized) for synthesis?
- Are you comfortable with an initial PoC on hosted infra or do you need private/VPC for the pilot?
- Procurement timeline and PO contact (we saw procurement@ in the call — who should we loop for SOW discussions?).

Attachments: Luminova_RFP.pdf (pdf stub), luminova-pilot-scope.xlsx (spreadsheet stub) — included with this thread.

Next steps (proposed):
1) You confirm pilot mode (hosted dev vs dedicated reserved).
2) We send a short SOW + pilot pricing ranges (no formal commitment).
3) Share sample traffic & anonymized prompt set (we'll sign an NDA if required).
4) Kickoff call next week to align SI/infra folks and timeline.

Thanks — I’ll loop Lauren for technical ops and Marcus for the cost modeling side.

—Sean
